name: Confer API is burning its error budget
summary: dex-api requests are slow or failing fast enough to break the SLO
description: The confer-api-fast SLO (95% of API requests succeed in under 2s) is spending its error budget too quickly. 1 means the budget runs out before the 28-day window ends. Start with the 'Confer: event health' dashboard: p95 by route, then Elasticsearch latency.
